meta.host: Render free web service (shared CPU, 512 MB RAM), Docker, Oregon (US)
meta.client: gradio_client on the developer laptop (India); warm instance
meta.seconds: median time from starting the upload to the server returning the result (upload + queue + processing + response)
meta.processing_s: enhancement time measured inside the app
meta.cold_start: Free instances sleep after ~15 min idle; the first request then waits roughly 30-60 s for the container to start (Render's documented behaviour, not measured here)
